0022600230.text: The Hornets (4-7) visit the Phoenix Suns (3-6) as they play their 12th game of the season, with Charlotte on a one-game win streak after a 3-7 stretch over its last ten, sitting 9th in the East and 2.5 games back in the Southeast. Charlotte is 1-3 on the road, while Phoenix, which has one more game to play before this one, is 3-3 at home, is 0-3 on the road, and enters on a one-game losing streak. Out for Charlotte are Dennis Schroder, Grant Williams, and Kon Knueppel, while Brandon Miller and Moussa Diabate are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix after shoulder surgery. The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the Hornets won the last meeting 127-107 in Charlotte on April 2, 2026, with no games yet between them this season.
